title: Seven dead, nine Chinese workers missing after fire at gas chemical complex in Russia
summary_full: A fire at a gas chemical complex in Russia's Amur region has claimed seven lives. Six Chinese nationals were among the deceased in the Tuesday incident. Nine more Chinese workers are currently missing after the blaze. The fire broke out at the facility and was later extinguished. The plant's press service confirmed the tragic events occurred.
